chunks: Over which you will see no curves or elevations.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the physical terrain of Hellfire in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'awaj' (unevenness) and 'amta' (curves/bends) are interpreted not merely as physical topography but as metaphors for the psychological and spiritual disorientation of the damned, reflecting their deviation from the straight path (Sirat al-Mustaqim) in life. This verse underscores the divine justice where the severity and nature of punishment correspond precisely to the specific sins and degrees of deviation of each individual, a concept emphasized by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni.
